diagnosis.stated_text: Allergic contact dermatitis, left upper eyelid
diagnosis.plain_language: Allergic contact dermatitis is an itchy, inflamed skin reaction that occurs when the skin touches a substance it is allergic to; here it is described on the left upper eyelid.

medications.name: Mometasone Furoate
medications.purpose_plain: Mometasone furoate is a corticosteroid ointment generally used to reduce skin inflammation, redness, and itching.

medications.name: Levocetirizine
medications.purpose_plain: Levocetirizine is an antihistamine tablet generally used to relieve allergy symptoms such as itching.

advice_verbatim: Avoid rubbing the area. Avoid new cosmetics or soaps near the eye.
